title: Amber HP bar during live Onix Ram charge

verification.actor: One current WILD Onix (species 95) at Route 29 map 33 tile (585,412), with the player at (585,407).
verification.trigger: Let Onix notice the stationary player and start its normal Ram Walk.
verification.observable: The native HP bar submits an amber warning while the Ram Walk is active, before HP loss.

setupMutations.change: Use checked teleport, native Wild Onix spawn and exact live identity bind. Do not change HP, condition, Ram policy or bar state.
No state mutation; the player stands still while Onix selects its normal Ram.

limits: Prepared placement tests the real Ram warning, not natural population spawn selection.
The checked native bar receipt proves submission, not final LCD pixels.
Missing current Onix, active Ram Walk, full HP, or amber submission fails.

events.value: Place and bind Onix five tiles south of the player.
Observe the Ram application and its first active Walk.
Read amber native bar submission before contact.

stop.condition: Active Ram Walk and same-boundary amber HP bar receipt, or first invalid actor, HP, or field observation.

invariants: Current Wild Onix owns the active Ram Walk
HP remains 100 with zero accepted hits
